entities.name: Indian Ocean Trade Network
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The oldest and longest-operating maritime trading system in world history (c. 3000 BCE – 16th century CE at its pre-European peak), connecting East Africa, Arabia, India, Southeast Asia, and China through monsoon-driven sailing. The network traded spices, textiles, gold, slaves, ceramics, and ideas, creating cosmopolitan port cities like Kilwa, Calicut, Malacca, and Guangzhou.
